property_summary: For any sequence of calls to play() with the correct msg.value, the final pot is either 0 (when a payout occurred on the last call) or a multiple of TICKET_AMOUNT (when the last call did not trigger a payout); in the mutant, because every call triggers an immediate full drain, the pot is always 0 after any call beyond the first.
change_summary: Change the modulo divisor from 2 to 1 so random is always 0, guaranteeing the transfer/reset branch executes every call.
